rejectedFinalists.reason: Rejected as primary because it pins an older Astro release with published high-severity advisory exposure, lacks tests and CI, and would import a generic Tailwind visual foundation.
Rejected because its CC BY-NC 4.0 license restricts commercial use, an application dependency is unpinned, and Once UI conflicts with the approved custom visual system.
Rejected because its old Astro and lint stack have published advisory exposure and its blog, RSS, MDX, and Tailwind foundations exceed version-one scope.
Rejected because the official template has no clear repository license, is behind current Next.js, and adds static-export image and localization complexity without a requirement benefit.
Rejected because it has no clear repository license, uses outdated Next.js and Nextra versions, lacks tests and CI, and its Next.js version falls within a published critical advisory range.
